meta.description: A thin closed skin between two attachments, like the veil between the cap margin and the stipe before it tears. Gives the skin as a thin sheet mesh, which stays sharp at any mesh resolution. Once it has torn, two skirt nodes hang the ring from the stipe and the fringe from the margin.

a.description: The first attachment, e.g. the margin of a cap. Points in a row (a ring when they go around) or paths.

b.description: The second attachment. A ring of points in a wraps around a point here, at the thickness of its path and across its tangent: a points_on_path on the stipe places the ring. Around a path it wraps level with a, a ring of points around the same axis is joined ring to ring, other attachments are joined as they are.

thickness.description: Thickness of the skin, 0 = no skin

sag.description: How far the middle of the skin hangs below the line between the attachments, as a share of their distance

resolution_curve.description: Points along a strand from one attachment to the other
